comparisons.name: add-remove-light
comparisons.description: Rounded add / remove pair, remove disabled, under the folder list of System Preferences Desktop & Screen Saver, Aqua. No text: the drawing alone.

comparisons.name: add-remove-dark
comparisons.description: Rounded add / remove pair, remove disabled, System Preferences Desktop & Screen Saver, Dark Aqua. No text: the drawing alone.

comparisons.name: connect-to-server-light
comparisons.description: Add, remove (disabled) and Action in Finder's Connect to Server, Aqua. The gear is masked: it is Apple's artwork and the example draws a stand-in of the same size.

comparisons.name: screen-time-light
comparisons.description: Separated style on white, third segment disabled, System Preferences Screen Time, Aqua. Whole crop, with the title Today in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: screen-time-light-bezel
comparisons.description: As screen-time-light with the title Today masked, to score the three bezels and the chevrons alone: the title is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: screen-time-dark
comparisons.description: Separated style, third segment disabled, System Preferences Screen Time, Dark Aqua. Whole crop, with the title Today in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: screen-time-dark-bezel
comparisons.description: As screen-time-dark with the title Today masked, to score the three bezels and the chevrons alone.

comparisons.name: print-mini-light
comparisons.description: Mini rounded page navigator on the Print sheet, both segments disabled, Aqua. No text. The sheet is vibrant: what is behind the control is the blurred desktop picture, which the example approximates with a gradient, so the mean delta is that of the background.

comparisons.name: print-mini-dark
comparisons.description: Mini rounded page navigator on the Print sheet, both segments disabled, Dark Aqua. No text. The sheet's vibrant background is approximated with a gradient, as in print-mini-light.

comparisons.name: tabs-light
comparisons.description: Selected first segment: the tab strip of System Preferences Sound, which AppKit draws as a select-one rounded segmented control, Aqua, blue accent. Whole crop, with the three titles in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: tabs-light-bezel
comparisons.description: As tabs-light with the three titles masked, to score the accent-filled segment, the bezel and the divider alone: titles are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: tabs-dark
comparisons.description: Selected first segment: the tab strip of System Preferences Sound, Dark Aqua, blue accent. Whole crop, with the three titles in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: tabs-dark-bezel
comparisons.description: As tabs-dark with the three titles masked, to score the accent-filled segment, the bezel and the divider alone.

comparisons.name: states-light
comparisons.description: The state fixture at rest: a select-one control with its first segment selected beside a disabled control, Aqua.

pixels.note: selected segment: middle stop of the blue accent bezel gradient (measured on the selected tab, spec: tab-view; tokens: accent.css)
the selected segment's accent covers the divider beside it (measured: accent to x=769 on the Sound tab strip)
fill of an unselected segment (spec: Fill, measured)
divider between two unselected segments, black at 10% over white (spec: Divider, measured)
disabled control: the bezel at half opacity over #ececec (tokens: controls.css, measured on a disabled push button)

comparisons.name: states-dark
comparisons.description: The state fixture at rest, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: selected segment: middle stop of the blue accent bezel gradient, dark (measured on the selected tab)
the selected segment's accent covers the divider beside it
fill of an unselected segment: white at 25% over the window background #323232 (spec measures #686869 over a #363637 box)
divider: black at 15% over that fill (spec measures #585859 over #686869)
disabled control: the bezel at half opacity, white at 12.5% over #323232 (spec: push-button measures #4a4a4b over #2f3031)

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: An unselected segment while the mouse is held down on it in the key window: it takes the accent bezel, Aqua.

pixels.note: middle stop of the measured blue gradient; that a pressed segment takes it is inferred (spec: segmented-control, States)
the segment between the selected and the pressed one is unchanged

comparisons.name: pressed-dark
comparisons.description: An unselected segment while pressed in the key window, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: middle stop of the measured blue gradient, dark; inferred as in pressed-light
the segment between the selected and the pressed one is unchanged

comparisons.name: pressed-selected-light
comparisons.description: The selected segment while pressed: the accent gradient darkened, Aqua.

pixels.note: 88% of the measured middle stop #3d88fd; the darkening is inferred (tokens: accent.css, pressed accent bezel)

comparisons.name: pressed-selected-dark
comparisons.description: The selected segment while pressed, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: 88% of the measured middle stop #1764db; inferred as above

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the first segment, reached with Tab: the ring is around the segment, not the control, Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over the window background, measured on the Go to Folder field (spec: focus-ring, sRGB)
outermost quarter point of the ring: the band is flat and reaches 2.5 pt beyond the bezel's edge
page just outside the ring (spec: focus-ring, Geometry)
the ring's inner side lies over the neighbouring segment: the ring colour, rgb(24 106 246) at 50%, over its white fill; computed from the token, placement inferred
the focused segment keeps its accent

comparisons.name: focus-ring-dark
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the first segment, reached with Tab, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over a dark window, measured in Automator (spec: focus-ring, sRGB)
outermost quarter point of the ring
page just outside the ring
the ring over the neighbouring segment: rgb(43 168 255) at 50% over its fill #656565; computed from the token, placement inferred

comparisons.name: window-main-light
comparisons.description: In a window that is main but not key, with keyboard focus on the first segment: the selected segment is grey and there is no focus ring, Aqua.

unselected fill, unchanged
no focus ring outside the key window (spec: focus-ring, States)

pixels.note: the shared pressed bezel fill (tokens: controls.css, --mac-bezel-fill-pressed; inferred, no screenshot)
